label: derived from public RELICS lens models (glafic v3, lenstool v2; MAST HLSP, maps scaled to D_LS/D_S = 1) and forced photometry; 2026-10-17; exploratory
h002_position: on image 1.1 of system 1 (0.26 arcsec from [MSF2019] 1c.1); model magnification 5.27 (glafic) and 5.22 (lenstool)
predicted_counter_images: both models: images at 7.3-7.6 arcsec (matching catalogued 1c.2 within ~0.1-0.3 arcsec), at 8.9-9.3 arcsec (near catalogued 1b.4), and at 25.4-25.5 arcsec (matching 1c.3 within 0.2 arcsec); predicted_images.json
position_uncertainty: model-to-model differences up to ~0.4 arcsec; the transient's exact counterpart position within the knot is not determined by a galaxy-scale model
magnifications: counter-images |mu| 1.9-3.0 (glafic and lenstool at 7.3-7.6 arcsec); the lenstool 8.9 arcsec image has mu -59.8 (near a critical curve, not reliable)
observations_at_counter_images: 1208 (2022-10-13) and VENUS (2025-10-06), F150W and F444W at all predicted positions (counter_image_lightcurves.ecsv); no new point source on the stamps at 7.3 and 25.4 arcsec; the 9.3 arcsec position is on a bright cluster-galaxy halo gradient
expected_signal: if visible, about 570 nJy x (|mu| 2-3 / 5.2), i.e. roughly 200-330 nJy in F150W at the 7.5 arcsec images, far above the forced-photometry errors (5-12 nJy)
interpretation: not testable with current epochs: the 7.5 arcsec images lag by about 650-830 days, so in 2025-10 they show image 1.1's state of about 2023-07 to 2023-12, when no data exist on image 1.1; a non-detection now is uninformative. The 25 arcsec image leads by about 12-14 years (about 2011-2014), before JWST
minimal_next_step: a NIRCam (or deep HST/WFC3-IR) epoch covering 1c.2 at about 2027-07 to 2028-01 (VENUS epoch 60954 + 650-830 d), or an archival HST epoch of 1c.3 from about 2011-2014 if one exists (not checked)
not_done: no lens model fitted or rebuilt; lenstool delays unavailable; archival HST of the 25 arcsec image not checked
